content_sections.heading: Important Dates
content_sections.text: The above recruitment and examination schedule is tentative as stated in the GPRB job alert.

content_sections.heading: GPRB Lokrakshak Cadre Vacancy 2026 - Post Details
content_sections.text: GPRB has announced a total of 3,000 vacancies under the Lokrakshak Cadre. The category-wise vacancy details are given below: The job alert also states that an increase in the number of vacancies is under consideration by the government.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply for GPRB Lokrakshak Cadre Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Candidates must have passed the 12th standard / Higher Secondary examination or an examination recognised as equivalent to Class 12 under the applicable Gujarat Government rules.

content_sections.heading: GPRB Lokrakshak Physical Test 2026
content_sections.text: The tentative physical test is expected to begin during December 2026 / January 2027. Candidates will have to qualify in the running test within the prescribed time limits. These running qualification standards are specifically mentioned in the new job alert.

content_sections.heading: GPRB Lokrakshak Written Exam 2026-27
content_sections.text: The written examination for the Lokrakshak Cadre recruitment is tentatively expected to be conducted in March / April 2027 . Candidates should note that this is a tentative schedule and the confirmed examination date will be announced separately by GPRB.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are announced under GPRB Lokrakshak Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: GPRB has announced a total of 3,000 vacancies for Lokrakshak Cadre Recruitment 2026-27.

faq.question: Q2. What is the category-wise vacancy distribution?
faq.answer: The 3,000 vacancies include 1,000 UPC posts, 1,000 APC posts and 1,000 SRPF posts.

faq.question: Q3. Can the number of GPRB Lokrakshak vacancies increase?
faq.answer: Yes. The job alert states that an increase in the number of vacancies is currently under consideration by the government.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for GPRB Lokrakshak Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates should have passed Class 12 / Higher Secondary or an equivalent examination recognised under the applicable Gujarat Government rules.

faq.question: Q5. When will the GPRB Lokrakshak Recruitment 2026 notification be released?
faq.answer: The recruitment advertisement is tentatively expected to be released in September / October 2026.
